about.title: About Ultimate Physique
about.subtitle: Scientific fitness assessment — track progress with data, and make training feel like leveling up.
about.missionBody: We build scientific, transparent, reproducible fitness scoring so you can see your level clearly — and make everyday training feel like leveling up in a game.
about.founderStory: Inspired by Arnold Schwarzenegger and Bruce Lee from an early age, Anndrew started training on his own at 10 — but without scientific coaching, progress stayed out of reach. In college, at 180 cm and only 55 kg with a severely low BMI, that firsthand struggle made clear how costly unguided training can be. He then apprenticed under the US Northwest Regional MMA Champion. Over 2.5 years he gained 28 kg (to 83 kg) while keeping body fat under 12%. That transformation put him on the path of exercise science and coaching — and became the origin of the Ultimate Physique assessment system.
founderCredentials: Muay Thai National Team Conditioning Coach
Basketball National Team Strength & Conditioning Coach
Collegiate Karate Championship Strength & Conditioning Coach
Strength & Conditioning Coach for Celebrity Clients
Coaching since 2012 — 500+ athletes coached and 25,000+ coaching hours
about.founderVisionLead: Combining a business-management background with exercise-science expertise, Anndrew built Ultimate Physique so anyone can use data-driven evaluation to:
founderVisionGoals: See their fitness level with clarity
Make training feel as rewarding as leveling up in a game
about.founderClosing: Let the numbers speak — let's get stronger together.
